paragraphs.text: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I gave order to the churches of Galatia, so also do ye.
paragraphs.original: Περὶ δὲ τῆς λογείας τῆς εἰς τοὺς ἁγίους, ὥσπερ διέταξα ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Γαλατίας, οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ποιήσατε.
paragraphs.translit: Peri de tēs logeias tēs eis tous hagious, hōsper dietaxa tais ekklēsiais tēs Galatias, houtōs kai hymeis poiēsate.

paragraphs.text: Upon the first day of the week let each one of you lay by him in store, as he may prosper, that no collections be made when I come.
paragraphs.original: κατὰ μίαν σαββάτου ἕκαστος ὑμῶν παρʼ ἑαυτῷ τιθέτω θησαυρίζων ὅ τι ἐὰν εὐοδῶται, ἵνα μὴ ὅταν ἔλθω τότε λογεῖαι γίνωνται.
paragraphs.translit: kata mian sabbatou hekastos hymōn parʼ heautō tithetō thēsaurizōn ho ti ean euodōtai, hina mē hotan elthō tote logeiai ginōntai.

paragraphs.text: And when I arrive, whomsoever ye shall approve, them will I send with letters to carry your bounty unto Jerusalem:
paragraphs.original: ὅταν δὲ παραγένωμαι, οὓς ἐὰν δοκιμάσητε διʼ ἐπιστολῶν, τούτους πέμψω ἀπενεγκεῖν τὴν χάριν ὑμῶν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ·
paragraphs.translit: hotan de paragenōmai, hous ean dokimasēte diʼ epistolōn, toutous pempsō apenenkein tēn charin hymōn eis Ierousalēm·

paragraphs.text: and if it be meet for me to go also, they shall go with me.
paragraphs.original: ἐὰν δὲ ἄξιον ᾖ τοῦ κἀμὲ πορεύεσθαι, σὺν ἐμοὶ πορεύσονται.
paragraphs.translit: ean de axion ē tou kame poreuesthai, syn emoi poreusontai.

paragraphs.text: But I will come unto you, when I shall have passed through Macedonia; for I pass through Macedonia;
paragraphs.original: Ἐλεύσομαι δὲ πρὸς ὑμᾶς ὅταν Μακεδονίαν διέλθω, Μακεδονίαν γὰρ διέρχομαι,
paragraphs.translit: Eleusomai de pros hymas hotan Makedonian dielthō, Makedonian gar dierchomai,

paragraphs.text: but with you it may be that I shall abide, or even winter, that ye may set me forward on my journey whithersoever I go.
paragraphs.original: πρὸς ὑμᾶς δὲ τυχὸν παραμενῶ ἢ καὶ παραχειμάσω, ἵνα ὑμεῖς με προπέμψητε οὗ ἐὰν πορεύωμαι.
paragraphs.translit: pros hymas de tychon paramenō ē kai paracheimasō, hina hymeis me propempsēte hou ean poreuōmai.

paragraphs.text: For I do not wish to see you now by the way; for I hope to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
paragraphs.original: οὐ θέλω γὰρ ὑμᾶς ἄρτι ἐν παρόδῳ ἰδεῖν, ἐλπίζω γὰρ χρόνον τινὰ ἐπιμεῖναι πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ἐὰν ὁ κύριος ἐπιτρέψῃ.
paragraphs.translit: ou thelō gar hymas arti en parodō idein, elpizō gar chronon tina epimeinai pros hymas, ean ho kyrios epitrepsē.

paragraphs.text: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost;
paragraphs.original: ἐπιμενῶ δὲ ἐν Ἐφέσῳ ἕως τῆς πεντηκοστῆς·
paragraphs.translit: epimenō de en Ephesō heōs tēs pentēkostēs·

paragraphs.text: for a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
paragraphs.original: θύρα γάρ μοι ἀνέῳγεν μεγάλη καὶ ἐνεργής, καὶ ἀντικείμενοι πολλοί.
paragraphs.translit: thyra gar moi aneōgen megalē kai energēs, kai antikeimenoi polloi.

paragraphs.text: Now if Timothy come, see that he be with you without fear; for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do:
paragraphs.original: Ἐὰν δὲ ἔλθῃ Τιμόθεος, βλέπετε ἵνα ἀφόβως γένηται πρὸς ὑμᾶς, τὸ γὰρ ἔργον κυρίου ἐργάζεται ὡς κἀγώ·
paragraphs.translit: Ean de elthē Timotheos, blepete hina aphobōs genētai pros hymas, to gar ergon kyriou ergazetai hōs kagō·

paragraphs.text: let no man therefore despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come unto me: for I expect him with the brethren.
paragraphs.original: μή τις οὖν αὐτὸν ἐξουθενήσῃ. προπέμψατε δὲ αὐτὸν ἐν εἰρήνῃ, ἵνα ἔλθῃ πρός με, ἐκδέχομαι γὰρ αὐτὸν μετὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν.
paragraphs.translit: mē tis oun auton exouthenēsē. propempsate de auton en eirēnē, hina elthē pros me, ekdechomai gar auton meta tōn adelphōn.

paragraphs.text: But as touching Apollos the brother, I besought him much to come unto you with the brethren: and it was not all [his] will to come now; but he will come when he shall have opportunity.
paragraphs.original: Περὶ δὲ Ἀπολλῶ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ, πολλὰ παρεκάλεσα αὐτὸν ἵνα ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς μετὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν· καὶ πάντως οὐκ ἦν θέλημα ἵνα νῦν ἔλθῃ, ἐλεύσεται δὲ ὅταν εὐκαιρήσῃ.
paragraphs.translit: Peri de Apollō tou adelphou, polla parekalesa auton hina elthē pros hymas meta tōn adelphōn· kai pantōs ouk ēn thelēma hina nyn elthē, eleusetai de hotan eukairēsē.

paragraphs.text: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
paragraphs.original: Γρηγορεῖτε, στήκετε ἐν τῇ πίστει, ἀνδρίζεσθε, κραταιοῦσθε.
paragraphs.translit: Grēgoreite, stēkete en tē pistei, andrizesthe, krataiousthe.

paragraphs.text: Let all that ye do be done in love.
paragraphs.original: πάντα ὑμῶν ἐν ἀγάπῃ γινέσθω.
paragraphs.translit: panta hymōn en agapē ginesthō.

paragraphs.text: Now I beseech you, brethren (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to minister unto the saints),
paragraphs.original: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί· οἴδατε τὴν οἰκίαν Στεφανᾶ, ὅτι ἐστὶν ἀπαρχὴ τῆς Ἀχαΐας καὶ εἰς διακονίαν τοῖς ἁγίοις ἔταξαν ἑαυτούς·
paragraphs.translit: Parakalō de hymas, adelphoi· oidate tēn oikian Stephana, hoti estin aparchē tēs Achaias kai eis diakonian tois hagiois etaxan heautous·

paragraphs.text: that ye also be in subjection unto such, and to every one that helpeth in the work and laboreth.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς ὑποτάσσησθε τοῖς τοιούτοις καὶ παντὶ τῷ συνεργοῦντι καὶ κοπιῶντι.
paragraphs.translit: hina kai hymeis hypotassēsthe tois toioutois kai panti tō synergounti kai kopiōnti.

paragraphs.text: And I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they supplied.
paragraphs.original: χαίρω δὲ ἐπὶ τῇ παρουσίᾳ Στεφανᾶ καὶ Φορτουνάτου καὶ Ἀχαϊκοῦ, ὅτι τὸ ὑμέτερον ὑστέρημα οὗτοι ἀνεπλήρωσαν,
paragraphs.translit: chairō de epi tē parousia Stephana kai Phortounatou kai Achaikou, hoti to hymeteron hysterēma houtoi aneplērōsan,

paragraphs.text: For they refreshed my spirit and yours: acknowledge ye therefore them that are such.
paragraphs.original: ἀνέπαυσαν γὰρ τὸ ἐμὸν πνεῦμα καὶ τὸ ὑμῶν. ἐπιγινώσκετε οὖν τοὺς τοιούτους.
paragraphs.translit: anepausan gar to emon pneuma kai to hymōn. epiginōskete oun tous toioutous.

paragraphs.text: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Prisca salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
paragraphs.original: Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τῆς Ἀσίας. ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς ἐν κυρίῳ πολλὰ Ἀκύλας καὶ Πρίσκα σὺν τῇ κατʼ οἶκον αὐτῶν ἐκκλησίᾳ.
paragraphs.translit: Aspazontai hymas hai ekklēsiai tēs Asias. aspazetai hymas en kyriō polla Akylas kai Priska syn tē katʼ oikon autōn ekklēsia.

paragraphs.text: All the brethren salute you. Salute one another with a holy kiss.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς οἱ ἀδελφοὶ πάντες. ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἁγίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: aspazontai hymas hoi adelphoi pantes. aspasasthe allēlous en philēmati hagiō.

paragraphs.text: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
paragraphs.original: Ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τῇ ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου.
paragraphs.translit: Ho aspasmos tē emē cheiri Paulou.

paragraphs.text: If any man loveth not the Lord, let him be anathema. Maranatha.
paragraphs.original: εἴ τις οὐ φιλεῖ τὸν κύριον, ἤτω ἀνάθεμα. Μαράνα θά.
paragraphs.translit: ei tis ou philei ton kyrion, ētō anathema. Marana tha.

paragraphs.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
paragraphs.original: ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ μεθʼ ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: hē charis tou kyriou Iēsou methʼ hymōn.

paragraphs.text: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
paragraphs.original: ἡ ἀγάπη μου μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hē agapē mou meta pantōn hymōn en Christō Iēsou.
